newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy government empowered to seek confidence on budget.
newsitem.headline: Italy government empowered to seek confidence on budget.

text.p: The Italian cabinet has authorised financial ministers to seek a confidence vote if necessary to speed the 1997 budget through the Senate (upper house), Treasury Ministry undersecretary Filippo Cavazzuti said on Friday.
"Yes, the authorisation already exists. It was given from the word go," he told reporters in response to questions.
The centre-left government has said more than 3,000 opposition amendments are blocking passage of the budget bill by an agreed Senate deadline of December 19.
The opposition has refused to withdraw the amendments and pro-government politicians said on Friday that ministers could seek up to five confidence votes to sweep them aside.
